body:
虽然您是我早年足球生涯的启蒙者，如今我真的感到悲哀，虽然你的脚法很硬，不过你确实踢到了钢板，我们看到了你发文道歉，但是你的不良言论中提及的人物，在中国人民心里不会原谅你，这根针会深深扎在中国人民的心里，享受着中国市场给你带来的红利，如今你的肖像不会出现在中国，姆巴佩，好自为之！
Although you were my mentor in my early football career, I truly feel saddened now. You possess formidable footwork, yet you have kicked against a steel plate. We have seen your public apology. However, the figure mentioned in your offensive remarks will never be forgiven by the Chinese people. This thorn will be deeply embedded in the hearts of the Chinese people. You once reaped huge benefits from the Chinese market, but your image will no longer appear in China. Mbappé, conduct yourself well.
#姆巴佩#
#姆巴佩道歉#
#谨代表个人发声#
#姆巴佩道歉不等于翻篇#
